title: zhongerxin/iPhone-use
why_read: A niche but technically interesting project letting an AI coding agent control a real iPhone over USB for automation and testing.
analysis: This project lets an AI coding assistant (Codex) drive a physical iPhone via USB, handling tasks like app installation, UI automation, and screen capture with fallback to screenshots when live streaming fails. It's a practical bridge between AI agents and real mobile hardware, useful for app testing, automation scripting, or exploring how far AI-driven device control can go. The approach of using USB-level control rather than purely software emulation suggests more reliable interaction with real app behavior than simulators. It's a specialized tool, likely most valuable to mobile QA engineers or those building AI agent-driven testing pipelines.
